title: The Docker's Cant
logline: A veteran wharf dockmaster coordinates off-the-books berth swaps using an archaic rhyming port argot, defying a corporate logistics auditor whose automated scheduling algorithms cannot parse the dialect.

roles.description: Directs orbital slip traffic with an inherited rhyming port argot; fiercely loyal to manual crane operators.
An efficiency specialist tasked with replacing dock banter with an automated dispatch algorithm; perpetually exasperated.
A light corporate patrol skiff used to verify berth timestamps and issue administrative fines.
The sprawling outer mooring ring where independent freighters dock amid acoustic horn signals.
The pressurized operations centre where automated scheduling servers monitor system commerce.

public_situation: Cargo delays mount at {role:wharf_berth_ring} as dockworkers refuse automated docking queues in favour of verbal acoustic calls.
private_truth: {role:wharf_dockmaster} uses rhyming dock slang to conceal unauthorized berth allocations for cash-strapped tramp freighters.

beats.public_change: The logistics division posts compliance monitors across all manual docking bays.

missions.reason: She needs an unaligned pilot to courier handwritten phonetic call sheets to crane foremen before the auditor inspects the slips.
missions.private_fact: She is using the call sheets to hide an undocumented fuel tanker parked in berth seventeen.

beats.public_change: {role:auditor_cutter} begins active sensor pinging of the acoustic horn relays.

missions.reason: The auditor hires the pilot to calibrate acoustic receivers around the slips to transcribe the rhyming calls into standard text.
missions.private_fact: He faces immediate dismissal if automated scheduling targets are not met by the end of the operating cycle.

beats.public_change: Corporate headquarters threatens to impound all manually docked hulls at the wharf ring.

missions.reason: She hires the pilot to retrieve the handwritten master slang ledger from her impounded office locker before security burns it.
missions.private_fact: The ledger contains fifty years of unrecorded safety overrides and informal debt agreements between crews.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the dockers' master slang ledger. The auditor offers a lucrative consultant bounty for the translation key, while the dockers need it to maintain their off-the-books mutual aid network.

options.label: Sell the slang lexicon to the auditor so corporate algorithms can decode every berth call
Return the lexicon to the dockmaster to protect the dockworkers' informal control
Sell the phrasebook to independent tramp captains for unmonitored docking access

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the slang ledger to the logistics auditor.
resolutions.summary: Corporate algorithms decode the wharf slang, automating all berths. {role:wharf_dockmaster} is demoted, and {role:logistics_auditor} secures his efficiency bonus.

consequences.public_summary: An outside courier sold the secret wharf dialect to the front office, ending fifty years of dockworker autonomy.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot returns the master lexicon to the dockmaster.
resolutions.summary: {role:wharf_dockmaster} preserves manual berth operations, while {role:logistics_auditor} is recalled in disgrace for failing to standardize port operations.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot recovered the old port phrasebook from corporate security, keeping the manual slips in docker hands.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells copies of the slang lexicon to independent freight runners.
resolutions.summary: Tramp freighters exploit the decoded calls to slip uninspected cargo past {role:wharf_berth_ring}. Both the auditor and dockmaster lose control of the slips.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot auctioned the wharf's secret docking codes to independent haulers, turning the berths into a smuggler free-for-all.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot fails to retrieve the ledger or ignores the contract.
resolutions.summary: {role:logistics_auditor} locks out the manual crane crews, causing massive freight logjams at {role:wharf_berth_ring} as ships drift without berth clearance.

loose_threads.detail: Acoustic horn callouts include an extra third stanza that corresponds to off-ledger debt balances.
A regional shipping trust listed future lease rights for the wharf berths three weeks before the audit started.
The manual berth override switch is certified with an operator badge belonging to an engineer retired a decade ago.

radio_hooks: Cargo delays continue at {role:wharf_berth_ring} as crane foremen insist on traditional verbal horn signals.
{role:corporate_dispatch_hub} denies allegations that algorithmic scheduling will eliminate manual docking shifts.
Tramp captains praise flexible berth assignments at outer docks, citing reasonable port customs.

voice_direction.wharf_dockmaster: Speaks in quick, staccato cadence laced with maritime idioms and port rhyming slang. Flatly ignores corporate terminology.
voice_direction.logistics_auditor: Nervous, fast-paced delivery, over-enunciating corporate buzzwords and efficiency metrics. Speaks in rigid, formulaic clauses and repeats compliance codes when flustered.
